title: Help me get my laser figured out.

posts.topic_title: Help me get my laser figured out.
posts.author: Jim McPherson
posts.post_subject: Help me get my laser figured out.
posts.content_md:
I got into holography a couple years ago but got out of the "habit". I'm now trying to get up and running again. I have an unknown laser diode and driver that I bought from Roithner when I started. For the life of me I can't remember what the configuration of the diode/photodiode is (eg. CCA, CAC, CCC). Fortunatly the driver and diode are soldered and working so I can take measurements to figure out what kind of configuration the diode is. 

The trouble is that I can't get my brain around how to measure it. When the diode is running I get a positive voltage from pin 2 to pin 1, and also have a positive voltage from pin 2 to pin 3. Any idea on what kind of diode I have, or how I can better measure it?

-Jim
